scope: All equal calls in current expression-correction verify.mjs and its two local importing control modules; prior sibling modules remain historical.
method: Inert source read and manual call-site classification; occurrence extraction is an index, not runtime validation or release authorization.

definition.source: export function equal(a, b, message) { requireThat(JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b), message); }

specialCases.rule: Retain rootSelectionSHA256 as SHA256(JSON.stringify(selection)); do not silently replace serialized-input identity with semantic equality identity.
Existing explicit String(run_attempt/run_id) normalization precedes equal; comparator replacement must not imply all ID types are newly strict.
Existing callsite-side sort is deliberate; comparator must never sort arrays generically.
Prior source-delta proof allows only admissionRelative replacement. Retain its historical result and author a distinct exact allowed-delta proof for the new comparator sibling.
verifyBinding does not whole-object-compare top-level selection. Unknown-key refusal claims are limited to compared objects unless a separately reviewed schema guard is added.
